signals.label: 屏幕和刘海的形状
signals.reads: 屏幕有几块、多大，有没有刘海
signals.purpose: 把控件放在对的那块屏、刘海旁边
signals.destination: 只在内存里用
signals.activation: 用到的时候读；打开隐私这一页时读一次
signals.toggle: 没有单独的开关，跟着刘海功能走
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 屏幕数量和刘海形状合起来，能看出你用的是哪一类 Mac，有没有接外接显示器。
signals.subtitle: 收进刘海时贴着机身

en.label: The shape of the display and the notch

en.activation: Read when needed, and once when the Privacy page opens

en.reads: How many displays there are, their sizes, and whether there's a notch

signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 锁屏状态和离开就锁的设置合起来，能看出你大概什么时候在桌前。
signals.subtitle: 锁屏时不画刘海、不动窗口

en.label: Whether the screen is locked
en.subtitle: No notch drawing and no window moves while locked
en.purpose: Does nothing while locked; picks up after unlocking
en.destination: Used in memory only
en.toggle: For safety this can't be turned off on its own
en.activation: Updated on locking and unlocking
en.combined: The lock state with Lock when you leave shows roughly when you're at your desk.
en.reads: Whether the screen is locked

signals.label: 配件电量
signals.reads: 这台 Mac 的电量、有没有插电、是否已充满、低电量模式；已连接配件的名字和电量；AirPods 连在这台 Mac 上时，读左耳、右耳、充电盒的电量
signals.purpose: 配件连上或电量低时，刘海说一句
signals.destination: 电量只在内存里用；提醒过的低电量记在这台 Mac 的设置里，免得重复提醒
signals.activation: 这台 Mac 的电源变化时（系统推送，不再定时读）；配件连上、断开时；已连着的配件每 2 分钟读一次；AirPods 成为声音输出时读一次，之后最多 10 分钟一次
signals.toggle: 设置里目前没有单独的开关
signals.retention: 低电提醒记录保存在本机设置，供重新启动后避免重复提醒
signals.combined: 配件的型号和电量合起来，能看出你用哪些配件、多久没充电。
signals.subtitle: 妙控鼠标、键盘、触控板、耳机

en.subtitle: Magic Mouse, keyboard, trackpad, headphones

en.toggle: No switch in Settings yet
en.activation: On this Mac's power changes (pushed, no more polling), and when an accessory connects or disconnects; connected accessories are read every 2 minutes; AirPods are read once when they become the output and at most every 10 minutes after
en.combined: Accessory models and battery together show which accessories you use and how long since they were charged.
en.reads: This Mac's battery level, whether it's plugged in, whether it's full and Low Power Mode; names and battery levels of connected accessories; with AirPods connected to this Mac, the levels of the left bud, right bud and case

en.activation: When rolling up, putting back and arranging
en.combined: Window titles and positions together show which file you're working on and which page you're reading.

signals.purpose: 你在菜单里选“检测面部动作”时，看你眨眼或转头；打开“有人在看时收起私人窗口”后，看有没有别人正对屏幕，有就把私人窗口收进刘海；打开认出你的实验后，锁屏时看是不是你

signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 摄像头画面和锁屏状态合起来，能看出你在不在座位上。

en.label: Camera
en.subtitle: Blinks, head turns and whether someone is watching
en.purpose: With Detect face motion on it watches blinks and head turns; with Roll up private windows while someone's watching it checks for someone facing the screen; with the recognition experiment it checks whether it's you while locked
en.destination: Used to decide, never uploaded
en.toggle: Roll up private windows while someone's watching, plus the camera permission in System Settings
en.activation: Detect face motion starts only when you pick it in the menu. Watching starts once apps are listed and you've been still for 30 seconds, at two frames a second, and stops on any keyboard or mouse input. Both stop while locked, asleep or switching users. Recognize you (experiment, off by default) starts when the screen lights up after locking, at up to 10 frames a second for 6 seconds, at most 3 times per lock; with the head-turn challenge it watches up to 12 more seconds after recognizing; it stops on sleep and user switches
en.combined: Camera pictures with the lock state show whether you're at your desk.
en.reads: In what the camera sees: which way the face turns, whether the eyes are open, and whether someone else faces the screen

signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 编程助手的事件合起来，能看出你在做哪个项目、什么时候在写代码。
signals.subtitle: 编程助手的状态放到刘海

signals.label: 指挥连接

signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 指挥连接合起来，能看出你在指挥哪个项目、哪段会话。

en.combined: Conductor connections show which project and which session you're conducting.
en.reads: The other side's identity in the same account, project and session ids, and a request summary

signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry

signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: Codex 的会话和审批合起来，能看出你在做什么项目、批准过哪些操作。
signals.subtitle: 发送你提交的内容

signals.reads: 实验：脸部裁出来的图像特征（Apple 的 Vision 算出）、登记过的模板、录入时眼睛睁开的程度、录入序号、比对结果；打开转头挑战后，还有转头时脸朝哪边、眼睛睁没睁开

signals.activation: 默认关闭；打开实验后，锁屏时屏幕亮起最多看 6 秒，每秒最多 10 帧；打开转头挑战，认出后再看最多 12 秒；每次锁屏最多 3 次，画面看不清不算次数
signals.toggle: 实验开关和删除登记；不会标成 Face ID
signals.verification: experimental: source + pure tests; default off; threshold uncalibrated; not run on hardware
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 人脸特征和摄像头画面合起来，能认出这是不是你。
signals.subtitle: 锁屏后认出是不是你

en.label: Face features and the comparison result
en.subtitle: Recognizes you after unlocking

en.combined: Face features and camera pictures together can tell whether it's you.
en.reads: Experiment: image features cropped from the face (computed by Apple's Vision), the enrolled template, how open the eyes were at enrolment, the enrolment number and the comparison result; with the head-turn challenge, also which way the face turns and whether the eyes are open

signals.activation: 遥控模式打开之后才宣告、接受连接；默认关
signals.toggle: 遥控模式；关掉就停止宣告、断开并停止监听
signals.verification: host lifecycle tests (tests/run-remote-host-tests.sh); no real-device run in app yet
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 遥控连接合起来，能看出你什么时候在用 iPhone 遥控这台 Mac、在同一个网络里。
signals.subtitle: iPhone 当遥控器

en.label: The iPhone remote's local connection to this Mac
en.subtitle: Your iPhone as a remote
en.purpose: Lets an iPhone work as a remote
en.destination: On this local network only; nothing uploaded
en.toggle: Remote mode; turning it off stops announcing, disconnects and stops listening
en.activation: Announces and accepts connections only after Remote mode is on; off by default
en.combined: Remote connections show when you're driving this Mac from an iPhone on the same network.
en.reads: Connection state, key and touch commands from the remote app on an iPhone on the same local network; other devices aren't read

signals.label: 私人 App 名单
signals.reads: 你在设置里选的私人 App（只存它们的标识）
signals.purpose: 有人在看、离开就锁、专注时，只处理名单里的 App
signals.destination: 存在这台 Mac 的设置里，不离开本机
signals.activation: 打开“私人 App”、添加或移除时；用到名单的功能触发时读
signals.toggle: 设置里的“私人 App”，随时可以移除
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 私人 App 名单和你的使用习惯合起来，能看出你在意保护哪些聊天和邮件。
signals.subtitle: 哪些 App 算私人

en.label: Your private app list
en.subtitle: Which apps count as private
en.purpose: Watching, Lock when you leave and Focus act only on the listed apps
en.destination: In this Mac's settings; it never leaves
en.toggle: The private app list in Settings; entries can be removed at any time
en.activation: When the private app list opens or an entry is added or removed, and when a feature that uses the list runs
en.combined: The private app list with your habits shows which chats and mail you care about protecting.
en.reads: The private apps you pick in Settings (only their identifiers are kept)

signals.label: 在局域网里出现的这台 Mac
signals.reads: 不读东西；把这台 Mac 的名字宣告给同一个局域网里的设备
signals.purpose: 让 iPhone 上的遥控器在列表里找到这台 Mac
signals.destination: 只在这个局域网里；不上传
signals.activation: 遥控模式打开时宣告，关掉就停
signals.toggle: 遥控模式
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 宣告的名字和遥控连接合起来，同一个网络里的人能看出这台 Mac 开着遥控模式、大概什么时候在用。
signals.subtitle: iPhone 能找到这台 Mac

en.label: This Mac as it appears on the local network
en.subtitle: The iPhone can find this Mac
en.purpose: Lets the iPhone remote find this Mac in its list
en.destination: On this local network only; nothing uploaded
en.toggle: Remote mode
en.activation: Announces while Remote mode is on, stopping when it's off
en.combined: The announced name with remote connections shows anyone on the same network that this Mac has Remote mode on and roughly when it's in use.
en.reads: Reads nothing; announces this Mac's name to devices on the same local network

signals.label: 用遥控器调音量
signals.reads: 当前输出音量；按音量键时在原来的基础上加减一格并写回
signals.purpose: 用 iPhone 上的遥控器调这台 Mac 的音量
signals.destination: 只在内存里；不发送
signals.activation: 遥控模式开着、iPhone 已连上、按了音量键时；不按键就不读不写
signals.toggle: 遥控模式；关掉就不再调
signals.retention: 不保存音量，只用这一次读到的值
signals.combined: 遥控器调过几次音量，合上连接的时段，能看出你什么时候在用遥控器；看不出你在听什么。
signals.subtitle: 遥控器的音量键

en.label: Volume changes from the remote
en.subtitle: The remote's volume buttons
en.purpose: Changes this Mac's volume from the iPhone remote
en.destination: In memory only; never sent
en.toggle: Remote mode; turning it off stops the changes
en.activation: With Remote mode on, an iPhone connected and a volume key pressed; nothing is read or written without a press
en.combined: How often you changed volume from the remote, with the times it was connected, shows when you use it; never what you listen to.
en.reads: The current output volume; a volume key adds or removes one step and writes it back

signals.label: 屏幕是否在被共享、专注模式是否开着
signals.group: 用了系统没公开的方法的
signals.reads: 屏幕有没有正在被共享或录制，系统专注模式开没开；只读“有”或“没有”，不读共享给了谁、专注模式的名字
signals.purpose: 共享屏幕时，私人 App 在刘海那一排里只显示图标，卡住提示不出声；专注模式开着时，短暂提醒只留一个小点
signals.destination: 只在内存里用，不记录，不发送
signals.activation: 启动时，以及切换 App、App 启动或退出、锁屏或解锁、换桌面时各读一次，不会定时去读；专注模式要你在这里打开开关、再在系统弹窗里同意后才读
signals.toggle: 专注模式：展开这一行，打开「专注模式时更安静」并在系统弹窗里同意才读，默认关；共享状态没有单独的开关，它只会让刘海更安静
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 是否在共享屏幕和是否开着专注模式合起来，能看出你大概正在开会或演示。
signals.subtitle: 共享或专注时刘海更安静

en.label: Whether the screen is shared and Focus is on
en.subtitle: The notch keeps quieter while sharing or in Focus
en.purpose: While sharing, private apps show only an icon in the notch row and stuck hints stay silent; in Focus a brief notice leaves just a dot
en.destination: In memory only; not recorded, not sent
en.toggle: Focus: expand this row, turn on Quieter in Focus and agree in the system prompt; off by default. Sharing has no switch of its own — it only quiets the notch
en.activation: At launch, and once each time you switch apps, an app launches or quits, the screen locks or unlocks, or you change desktops; no timers. Focus is read only after you turn the switch on here and agree in the system prompt
en.combined: Whether the screen is shared with whether Focus is on shows you're probably in a meeting or presenting.
en.reads: Whether the screen is being shared or recorded and whether Focus is on; only yes or no is read, never who it's shared with or the name of the Focus

signals.label: 文件拷贝的进度
signals.reads: Finder 拷贝文件时系统公开的进度：做了多少、一共多少、第几个，以及正在拷的文件名；只看下载、桌面、文稿三个文件夹里的
signals.purpose: 在刘海上显示拷到哪了和拷没拷完；不读文件内容，不去数文件夹
signals.destination: 只在内存里；不发送，不写运行记录
signals.activation: 只在你打开这个实验功能之后；进度有变化时才收到，没有轮询
signals.toggle: 设置 > 实验 > 拷贝进度，默认关
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 拷贝的文件名合起来，能看出你最近在整理什么；文件内容看不到。
signals.subtitle: 显示拷到哪了

en.label: Progress of file copies
en.subtitle: Shows how far the copy has got
en.purpose: Shows copy progress in the notch; never reads file contents or counts folders
en.destination: In memory only; not sent, not logged
en.toggle: Settings > Experiments > Copy progress, off by default
en.activation: Only after you turn on this experiment; updates arrive on change, never by polling
en.combined: Filenames of copies together show what you've been organizing; contents stay invisible.
en.reads: The progress Finder publishes while copying: how much is done, of how much, which item, and the filename; only in Downloads, Desktop and Documents

signals.label: 音量和亮度键
signals.reads: 音量 +/−、静音、亮度 +/−、键盘灯 +/− 这几个系统按键的按下和松开；只订阅系统按键这一类，打字的键收不到。按下时读默认输出设备能不能调、它的传输方式（内建、蓝牙、HDMI 等）和型号名（只为认出 AirPods 和耳机、换左边的符号）、当前音量和静音、内建屏亮度、键盘灯亮度，以及系统“调音量时播放反馈”
signals.purpose: 拦下这几个键，由刘海显示，系统自己的提示藏起来；拦下的那一下照系统的步长写回系统输出音量与静音、内建屏亮度、键盘灯亮度，写完读回核对，不对就把这一下原样交还系统
signals.destination: 只在内存里；不发送，不写运行记录
signals.activation: 只在允许了辅助功能、且这个 macOS 版本核对过时；按了这几个键才读才写，平时不轮询
signals.toggle: 设置里的“音量和亮度”（默认开）；没允许辅助功能或版本没核对过就只旁听
signals.retention: 不保存按键和数值，只用这一下读到的值；写回失败过的键类只记到这次开机结束
signals.combined: 这几个键什么时候被按过、音量和亮度调成多少，合上你的使用时段，能看出你什么时候在用这台 Mac、是不是在看片或听东西；看不出你在听什么、看什么，也收不到你打的字。
signals.subtitle: 按音量、亮度键时显示

en.label: Volume and brightness keys
en.subtitle: Shows when you press volume or brightness keys
en.purpose: Catches these keys and shows them at the notch instead; the change is written back at the system's own step and read back to check, and handed back if it doesn't match
en.destination: In memory only; not sent, not logged
en.toggle: Volume and brightness in Settings (on by default); without Accessibility or a verified version it only listens
en.activation: Only with Accessibility granted and this macOS version verified; read and written on those key presses, never polled
en.combined: When these keys were pressed and how far you turned volume and brightness up, with the hours you use the Mac, show when you're using it and whether you're watching or listening; never what you watch or hear, and never what you type.
en.reads: Presses and releases of the system keys volume +/−, mute, brightness +/− and keyboard backlight +/−; only this class of system key is subscribed to, so typing keys never arrive. On a press it reads whether the default output can be adjusted, its transport (built-in, Bluetooth, HDMI and so on) and model name (only to recognize AirPods and headphones and swap the symbol on the left), the current volume and mute, the built-in display's brightness, the keyboard backlight level, and the system's Play feedback when changing volume

signals.label: 日程
signals.reads: 未来 24 小时内日程的开始和结束时间、标题、地点、链接、备注（只在里面找会议链接）、你的回复状态、日历颜色
signals.purpose: 快开会时，刘海提前倒数提醒；有会议链接时可以直接加入
signals.destination: 只在内存里，不存，不外发；备注读完就扔
signals.activation: 启动时（已允许的话）、日历有改动时、每个日程开始前（设置里选 1 / 5 / 10 / 15 分钟，默认 5）；只查未来 24 小时；有日程要倒数时才挂一次性定时器，最后一分钟和日程大卡开着时每秒换一次字，平时不轮询
signals.toggle: 设置里的「日程」开关，默认关；欢迎窗口第三步点「允许」、再在系统弹窗里同意后才读
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 日程的时间、标题和地点合起来，能看出你什么时候在哪、和谁开会。
signals.subtitle: 快开会时提醒你

en.label: Calendar
en.subtitle: Tells you just before a meeting
en.purpose: The notch counts down before a meeting, and can join when there's a link
en.destination: In memory; notes are dropped once read
en.toggle: The Calendar switch in Settings, off by default; the welcome screen's step three and the system prompt both have to agree first
en.activation: At launch (if granted), on calendar changes and before each event (1 / 5 / 10 / 15 minutes, 5 by default); only the next 24 hours; a one-shot timer is set only when there's something to count down, ticking each second in the last minute and while the card is open, never polled
en.combined: Event times, titles and places together show when and where you meet, and with whom.
en.reads: Start and end times, titles, places, links and notes of events in the next 24 hours (searched only for meeting links), your reply status, and calendar colours

signals.label: 放进文件架的东西
signals.reads: 你放进文件架的文件在哪、叫什么；拖进来的文字、图片、链接本身
signals.purpose: 下次还在文件架上：拖出去、预览、隔空投送
signals.destination: 只在这台 Mac：~/Library/Application Support/WindowShade/文件架/；不发送，不写运行记录
signals.activation: 只在你松在“暂存”上时记；打开文件架、启动、接拔磁盘时检查还在不在
signals.toggle: 设置 > 刘海 > 文件架（默认开，关掉即清空）
signals.combined: 文件架上的名字合起来，能看出你最近在忙什么。
signals.subtitle: 记住你暂存的东西
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry

en.label: What you put on the file shelf
en.subtitle: Remembers what you put aside
en.purpose: Still on the shelf next time: drag out, preview, AirDrop
en.destination: On this Mac only: ~/Library/Application Support/WindowShade/File Shelf/; not sent, not logged
en.toggle: Settings > Notch > File shelf (on by default; turning it off clears it)
en.activation: Recorded only when you drop on Park; the shelf is checked on open, at startup and on disk changes
en.combined: Names on the file shelf together show what you've been busy with.
en.reads: Where the files you put on the shelf are and what they're called; the text, images and links you drag in themselves

signals.label: 正在拖的是哪一类
signals.reads: 正在拖的是文件、文字、图片还是链接，有几个；不看内容
signals.purpose: 拖近刘海时垂下对的落点小岛
signals.destination: 只在内存里用
signals.activation: 只在拖动期间
signals.toggle: 跟着文件架走
signals.combined: 只知道你拖的是哪一类，看不出是什么内容。
signals.subtitle: 拖近刘海时认出是哪一类
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry

en.label: What kind of thing you're dragging
en.subtitle: Recognizes the kind of thing as you drag it near the notch
en.purpose: Drops the right landing island as you drag near the notch
en.destination: Used in memory only
en.toggle: Follows the file shelf
en.activation: Only while dragging
en.combined: All that's known is what kind of thing you dragged, never its content.
en.reads: Whether you're dragging files, text, images or links, and how many; contents aren't looked at

signals.label: 声音输出设备
signals.reads: 系统“声音”里能选的输出设备的名字、类型和哪一个是当前的；设备名里可能有你的名字，比如“小明的 AirPods”
signals.purpose: 在正在播放的大卡上，选声音从哪里出来，并按图标认出现在用的是耳机、音箱还是这台 Mac
signals.destination: 只在内存里，设备名不写进运行记录，不发送；你选定后，只把系统默认输出换成那一个
signals.activation: 打开正在播放的大卡时读一次当前设备的类型；点“播放到”时读一次全部；没有常驻监听，不定时去读
signals.toggle: 设置里的“正在播放”关掉，大卡就不会开
signals.retention: 设备名只在列表开着的时候留在内存里，收起就丢
signals.combined: 你的设备名合起来，能看出你有哪些耳机和音箱，有的还带着你的名字；看不出你在听什么。
signals.subtitle: 大卡里选声音从哪里出来

en.label: Sound output devices
en.subtitle: Pick where the sound comes out, in the card
en.purpose: Picks where sound comes out in the Now Playing card, and tells headphones, speakers and this Mac apart by icon
en.destination: In memory; device names stay out of the logs; picking one only switches the system's default output
en.toggle: Turn Now Playing off in Settings and the card won't open
en.activation: The current device type is read once when the card opens; everything is read when you pick Play to; no permanent listener and no timers
en.combined: Your device names together show which headphones and speakers you own, some carrying your name; never what you're listening to.
en.reads: Names and types of the output devices offered in the system's Sound settings, and which one is current; device names may carry your name, like “Alex's AirPods”

signals.label: 交给隔空投送的东西
signals.reads: 只交出去，不读；只知道成没成
signals.purpose: 把文件直接投给附近的设备
signals.destination: 交给系统的隔空投送；我们不知道发给了谁
signals.activation: 只在你松在“隔空投送”上时
signals.toggle: 没有单独的开关
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 只知道你投过东西、成没成，不知道发给了谁，也不留文件名。
signals.subtitle: 把东西交给隔空投送

en.label: What you hand to AirDrop
en.subtitle: Hands things to AirDrop
en.purpose: Hands files straight to nearby devices
en.destination: Handed to the system's AirDrop; we don't see who received it
en.toggle: No switch of its own
en.activation: Only when you drop on AirDrop
en.combined: All that's known is that you handed something over and whether it worked — not who received it, and no filename is kept.
en.reads: Only hands things over, reads nothing; all that's known is whether it worked

signals.label: 播放的声音大小
signals.reads: 正在放歌的那个 App 的声音有多大，分成高低 5 段；只听它一个，声音本身不留下
signals.purpose: 让刘海右边的小点随正在放的歌起伏
signals.destination: 只在内存里，每秒换成 30 次 5 个数画出来；不存，不发送，不写进运行记录
signals.activation: 刘海露着正在放的歌、或大卡开着，而且在放时才听；暂停 3 秒、收回、锁屏、全屏就停；输出是蓝牙耳机、来源是 Spotify 时不听
signals.toggle: 设置里的“跟着声音跳”，默认关；打开时系统才问你“系统音频录制”
signals.retention: 声音不留下；离开录音那一路的只有每帧 5 个数
signals.combined: 声音大小合上正在放的歌，能看出你什么时候在听。
signals.subtitle: 刘海右边的小点随歌起伏

en.label: How loud playback is
en.subtitle: A dot on the notch's right rises and falls with the song
en.purpose: Rises and falls with the song on the notch's right
en.destination: In memory; drawn 30 times a second from 5 numbers; nothing stored, sent or logged
en.toggle: Bounce with the sound in Settings, off by default; turning it on is when the system asks about System Audio Recording
en.activation: Listens while the notch shows the song, or the card is open, and something is playing; stops after 3 seconds paused, when tucked, locked or full screen; not while the output is Bluetooth headphones or the source is Spotify
en.combined: Loudness with the song playing shows when you're listening.
en.reads: How loud the app that's playing is, in five steps from quiet to loud; only that app is listened to and the sound itself isn't kept

signals.label: 脸部画面清不清楚
signals.reads: 实验：脸部画面清不清楚、亮不亮、有没有反光，画面里有没有屏幕或手机的边框
signals.purpose: 提示怎么拍得更清楚；看出有人举着照片或手机，就算没认出
signals.destination: 只在内存里判断，不存画面，不上传
signals.activation: 跟着刷脸解锁（实验）：锁屏后屏幕亮起才看，最多 6 秒；屏幕和手机的边框每 3 帧看一次
signals.toggle: 刷脸解锁（实验）的开关
signals.verification: experimental: source + pure tests; default off; thresholds uncalibrated; not run on hardware
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 画面清不清楚和脸部特征合起来，能看出镜头前是真人还是照片。
signals.subtitle: 看清镜头前是不是真人

en.label: Whether the face picture is clear
en.subtitle: Checks whether a real person is in front of the camera
en.purpose: Hints at a clearer shot; a held-up photo or phone counts as no match
en.destination: Decided in memory; no picture kept, nothing uploaded
en.toggle: The face unlock (experimental) switch
en.activation: Follows face unlock (experimental): it looks only when the screen lights up after locking, up to 6 seconds; screen and phone edges are checked every 3 frames
en.combined: How clear the picture is, with face features, shows whether a real person is in front of the camera or a photo.
en.reads: Experiment: how clear and bright the face picture is, whether it glares, and whether a screen or phone edge appears in it

signals.label: CarPlay 全屏连的外部接收器
signals.reads: 你填的那台接收器送来的 iPhone 画面、画面参数和会话状态
signals.purpose: 在刘海全屏里显示 iPhone 的 CarPlay 画面
signals.destination: 只连你填的接收器地址；画面在这台 Mac 上解码显示，触摸和按键也只发给它
signals.activation: CarPlay 全屏开着且你填了接收器地址才连；默认关
signals.toggle: 不填接收器地址就只看示意画面；清掉地址即不连
signals.verification: receiver wire/session/surface tests; real-device run pending
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 接收器连接合起来，能看出你什么时候把手机画面放到这台 Mac 的全屏里。
signals.subtitle: iPhone 的画面从接收器来

en.label: An external receiver CarPlay connects to full screen
en.subtitle: The iPhone's picture comes through the receiver
en.purpose: Shows the iPhone's CarPlay picture in the notch full screen
en.destination: Connects only to the receiver address you entered; the picture decodes here and touches and keys go back to it
en.toggle: With no receiver address it shows a sample picture; clearing the address disconnects
en.activation: Connects only with CarPlay full screen on and a receiver address entered; off by default
en.combined: Receiver connections show when you put a phone's picture full screen on this Mac.
en.reads: The iPhone picture sent by the receiver you entered, its picture parameters and the session state

signals.label: 随身蓝牙设备的在不在
signals.reads: 你选的那台已配对蓝牙设备连没连着，以及连着时的信号强度
signals.purpose: 设备走远了就锁屏
signals.destination: 只在内存里用；不上传
signals.activation: 离开就锁打开且选了随身设备后，每隔几秒读一次连接状态
signals.toggle: 离开就锁的开关；清空随身设备的选择即停
signals.verification: model tests; real-device duty cycle not observed yet
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 随身设备的连接与断开合起来，能看出你什么时候带着它离开这台 Mac。
signals.subtitle: 设备走远就锁屏

en.label: Whether your Bluetooth device is nearby
en.subtitle: Locks when the device walks away
en.purpose: Locks when the device walks away
en.destination: In memory only; nothing uploaded
en.toggle: The Lock when you leave switch; clearing the device choice stops it
en.activation: With Lock when you leave on and a device picked, the connection is read every few seconds
en.combined: Your pocket device connecting and disconnecting shows when you take it away from this Mac.
en.reads: Whether the paired Bluetooth device you picked is connected, and its signal strength while connected

signals.label: 卸载 App 时读到的关联文件
signals.reads: 你右键要卸载的那个 App 的用户域关联文件清单（偏好、应用支持、缓存、窗口状态、容器、启动代理等）和它们的大小
signals.purpose: 把 App 和它的关联文件一起移到废纸篓（可找回）
signals.destination: 清单只在卸载浮层里给你看；文件进废纸篓，不上传
signals.activation: 你在这个 App 的右键菜单里点「卸载 App…」才扫；功能开关默认关
signals.toggle: 启动台卸载的开关；每次还有勾选确认，不勾的不动
signals.verification: plan tests (tests/run-app-uninstall-tests.sh); real fixture flow pending
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 卸载的文件清单合起来，能看出这个 App 在这台 Mac 上留下过什么。
signals.subtitle: 删 App 连文件进废纸篓

en.label: Related files seen when uninstalling an app
en.subtitle: Uninstalling takes its files to the Trash
en.purpose: Moves the app and its related files to the Trash (recoverable)
en.destination: The list shows only in the uninstall panel; files go to the Trash, nothing is uploaded
en.toggle: The Launchpad uninstall switch; each run asks for a tick, and unticked items are left alone
en.activation: Scans only when you pick Uninstall App… in the app's context menu; the switch is off by default
en.combined: The uninstall file list together shows what this app left behind on the Mac.
en.reads: The list of user-domain files belonging to the app you're uninstalling (preferences, application support, caches, window state, containers, launch agents and the like) and their sizes

signals.label: 崩溃报告
signals.reads: 系统为 WindowShade 留在这台 Mac 上的崩溃报告（~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports）、WindowShade 自己在崩溃后记下的报告（只在这台 Mac 的运行记录文件夹里，最多 10 份），以及运行记录
signals.purpose: 打包成一个文件夹，你看过再决定交给谁
signals.destination: 只写进这台 Mac 的运行记录文件夹，并在访达里显示；不上传
signals.activation: 崩溃后下次打开时存一份（只存在这台 Mac 上）；导出诊断包时才读出来
signals.toggle: 没有开关：不导出就不读
signals.retention: see destination; no new polling or telemetry
signals.combined: 崩溃报告合起来，能看出这台 Mac 的型号、系统版本，和当时同时开着哪些 App。
signals.subtitle: 只在你导出诊断包时读

en.label: Crash reports
en.subtitle: Read only when you export diagnostics
en.reads: Crash reports macOS keeps on this Mac for WindowShade (~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports), the reports WindowShade itself writes after a crash (only in the activity log folder on this Mac, at most 10), plus the activity log
en.purpose: Bundled into one folder for you to look over before deciding whom to give it to
en.destination: Written only to the activity log folder on this Mac and shown in Finder; never uploaded
en.activation: After a crash, one is saved the next time the app opens (on this Mac only); it is read out only when you export diagnostics
en.toggle: No switch: nothing is read unless you export
en.combined: Crash reports together show this Mac's model, its macOS version and which apps were open at the time.
